paite: Judahte lak ah Pathian theih in a-om a; Israelte lak ah amin athupi hi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Vualzoupa Pathian

paite: Salem ah biakbuk a-om a. Amah omna Zion ah a-om hi.
Huai ah thalpeu thalte ahihsia a; phawte, namsaute, kidouna vanzatte toh. Selah
Nang thupitak leh hoihtak na hi a, sathah tangte sang in.
Lungtang phate'n suam atuak ua, a-ihmu uh a-ihmu denta uhi; mihatte leng kuamah in akhut uh alik theita kei uhi.
Jakob' Pathian aw, na sawina ziak in kangtalai leh sakol leng gen ding thei lou in a-om tuaktuak uhi.
Nang, nangmah mah, lau ding na hi; na heh peuhmah leh, kua ahia na mitmuh a dingh thei ding?
Na vaihawm thu van a kipan in na theisak a; lei alau a, adaita hi.
Lei a mi thunuailut tengteng hondam ding leh vaihawm ding a Pathian athoh lai in. Selah
Pel lou in mihing hehna in nang ahon phat ding a, hehna kawnggak in na kigak ding hi.
Thu chiam inla, TOUPA na Pathian uh lak ah hihtangtung un; akim a mi tengteng in kihtak dingpa kipahmante hon tawisak uhen.
Ama'n lalte kha asatkhe ding a; amah lei a kumpipate a ding in akihtakhuai ahi.
